authorship: Project-authored evidence projection from the preserved RCSB PDB mmCIF; not an RCSB-authored annotation.

cited_context_not_redistributed.purpose: Primary article for 2QUT; its abstract reports native and Lys146Met rabbit aldolase DHAP complexes and the enamine intermediate at Lys229 in native aldolase.
Current curated record labels P00883 Lys230 as the Schiff-base site with dihydroxyacetone phosphate; no UniProt response body is redistributed here.
Supporting NaBH4-reduced covalent trap generated in the presence of FBP, consistent with a DHAP-Schiff-base precursor; 1J4E is an engineered four-Cys mutant and is not copied into this package.
Separate Thermoproteus tenax mutant context for archaeal ring-opening analysis; it does not establish rabbit applicability or an archaeal Lys229.

extracted_values.title: Dihydroxyacetone phosphate enamine intermediate in fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase from rabbit muscle

claims.interpretation: The deposit identifies 2QUT as a rabbit-muscle fructose-bisphosphate aldolase structure containing a dihydroxyacetone-phosphate enamine intermediate.
limits: A structure title identifies the trapped state; it does not establish reaction direction, temporal order, or every elementary electron-flow assertion in M-CSA M0222.
The word enamine in the title does not by itself distinguish how the intermediate was generated experimentally.

items.title: Dihydroxyacetone phosphate enamine intermediate in fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase from rabbit muscle

claims.interpretation: Chain A is the deposited rabbit ALDOA polymer aligned to UniProt P00883 residues 2-364. This establishes the one-residue numbering offset: PDB-author Lys229 corresponds to P00883 Lys230.
limits: The raw CIF records `_entity.pdbx_mutation` as the unknown marker `?`; it does not explicitly label the construct 'native'.
The raw CIF contains no `_struct_ref_seq_dif` category and gives a full 363-residue alignment to P00883 residues 2-364, but category absence alone is not an experimental native-state assertion.
The primary-article abstract describes native and Lys146Met complexes and assigns the native enamine to Lys229; that cited context is not redistributed in this audit package.

claims.interpretation: The deposited chain-A structure contains a covalent connection between PDB-author Lys229 NZ and C2 of ligand component 13P, which the CIF names 1,3-dihydroxyacetone phosphate. Through the deposited alignment, this lysine is P00883 Lys230.
limits: This connection resolves the deposited DHAP parent-moiety designation for this captured 2QUT adduct; it does not prove that free DHAP attack was directly observed.
It does not validate the complete M0222 ordered mechanism, proton transfers, atom mapping, or physiological direction.
It does not transfer the rabbit residue number Lys229 to archaeal proteins.
The deposited _struct_conn.pdbx_value_order is unknown (?). Protonation is unobserved; CCD 13P is a component label, and no exact bound ChEBI identity is assigned.

scope: Exact deposited identity, chain-A reference alignment, and chain-A covalent connection only.
